title: Expenses, photos and Turkish
items: A single expense ledger grouped by UK tax year.
Short stays with a total price, property photos and Turkish throughout the app.

title: Maintenance and document controls
items: Scheduled and recurring jobs, contractor contacts and property assets.
Private document storage and organisation roles.
Configurable retention controls, previews and legal holds.

title: Rent and inventory

Condition and cleanliness ratings with dated photographs.
Check-in/check-out comparison, PDF exports and portfolio analytics.

title: The foundations

Private calendar subscriptions and installation to a phone’s home screen.
